methodologyNotes: Covers COB (chip-on-board) LED continuous video/photo lights: single-point studio and location fixtures with a COB emitter and a standard accessory mount, sold at a published US price. Includes daylight, bi-color, and RGBWW COB monolights (point-source fixtures that take a reflector or softbox); excludes LED panel lights, tube/pixel lights, on-camera flat panels, and ring lights. Price is typical US MSRP or street price, USD, for the fixture head as configured. powerWatts is the fixture's rated draw in watts. outputLuxAt1m is the manufacturer's illuminance in lux measured at 1 metre (with the standard/no reflector spec the maker publishes; note the reflector when stated). cctMode is an enum for color capability: 'daylight' (fixed ~5600K), 'bi-color' (variable white), or 'rgbww' (full-color). cctRangeKelvin is the correlated-color-temperature range as a string (e.g. '2700-6500'); for a daylight fixture it is the single rated value. criMin is the manufacturer's minimum stated CRI (Ra). tlciMin is the minimum stated TLCI. beamAngleDeg is the native beam angle in degrees (bare bulb / stock reflector). mountType is the accessory-mount standard (e.g. 'Bowens', 'proprietary'). powerSource is an enum: 'ac', 'battery', or 'ac-and-battery' (V-mount/NP-F). cooling is an enum: 'active-fan', 'passive', or 'hybrid'. weightGrams is the head weight in grams. Any spec not stated verbatim on a fetched manufacturer or retailer/review page is left null.
